policy: Both requests reset KV and prefill prompt[:-1] in canonical chunks8 with B4 tails; Both use FP64 prefill projections and FP32 scalar final-prompt/decode. Both retain batched prefill attention; Reference is deployed f17 with one8-worker pool; candidate uses12 for explicit prefill commands and8 for scalar/verification with two resident pools. Source arithmetic unchanged; separately linked executables. One shared mainmodel/KV. No core placement guarantee. No prefix reuse or suffix verification.
limitations: Two resident models: reference8 worker threads, candidate20 resident worker threads, each with one KV store. Sequential warmed inference in alternating order. This measures full deployment composition including host/layout/pool overhead, not isolated worker-count causality. Separate same-binary OFF comparison exists; do not multiply its ratios. Direct acknowledged/closed dumps preserve worker pools after warmup. No OS cache eviction or hard host isolation. Full-logit bits and fixed greedy IDs must match; separate causal/cache/sampled verification gates required.
